changeSet.author: str-backend
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE str_rn.accommodation DROP CONSTRAINT chk_accommodation_offer_type
UPDATE str_rn.accommodation SET offer_type = 'PRIMARY_RESIDENCE' WHERE offer_type = 'RESIDENCE'
ALTER TABLE str_rn.accommodation ADD CONSTRAINT chk_accommodation_offer_type CHECK (offer_type IN ('PRIMARY_RESIDENCE', 'SECONDARY_RESIDENCE', 'OTHER'))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE str_rn.accommodation DROP CONSTRAINT chk_accommodation_offer_type
UPDATE str_rn.accommodation SET offer_type = 'RESIDENCE' WHERE offer_type IN ('PRIMARY_RESIDENCE', 'SECONDARY_RESIDENCE')
ALTER TABLE str_rn.accommodation ADD CONSTRAINT chk_accommodation_offer_type CHECK (offer_type IN ('RESIDENCE', 'OTHER'))
